source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of investment and savings (PDF 218-219).

items: Sarmayakari: mustaqbil ke munafe ke liye karobar ya project mein paisa lagana; Islamabad ki kapron ki dukaan naye maal par Rs 50,000 lagati hai zyada mein bechne ki umeed par.

Bachat: mustaqbil ki zarooraton, jaise saaman, wusat ya hangami haalat, ke liye paisa alag rakhna; Peshawar ka restaurant Rs 10,000 mahana bacha kar saal baad naye oven ke liye Rs 120,000 jama karta hai.

blocks.text: Kitab batati hai ke Pakistan mein bohat log sona khareed kar bachat karte hain, jise qeemat mehfooz rakhne ka zariya samjha jata hai. Har asase ki tarah sone ki qeemat gir bhi sakti hai, to yeh aam riwaj ka bayan hai, mashwara nahi.

blocks.prompt: Karobar ke liye ek aham maali tasawwur bayan kijiye (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Profit: revenue minus tamam kharche. Yeh dikhata hai ke karobar asal mein paisa kama raha hai ya nahi, aur is ka hissa bachaya ya dobara lagaya ja sakta hai.

items: Sarmayakari ab kharch kar baad mein kamati; bachat paisa alag rakhti (Rs 10,000 x 12 = Rs 120,000).
